summary: New bigint column kept in sync by a trigger, batched backfill, swap after retirement (metadata-only steps plus a NOT VALID / VALIDATE NOT NULL).

stages.description: Copy every write into the new column.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ADD COLUMN number_of_orders_new bigint
CREATE TRIGGER migproto_orders_sync BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON account_user FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION migproto_orders_sync()
WITH batch AS (SELECT id FROM account_user WHERE number_of_orders_new IS NULL LIMIT 10000) UPDATE account_user u SET number_of_orders_new = u.number_of_orders FROM batch WHERE u.id = batch.id

stages.description: Deploy the new version; its migration only updates Django state.
Swap in one short metadata transaction, then validate without blocking writes.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user DROP COLUMN number_of_orders
ALTER TABLE account_user RENAME COLUMN number_of_orders_new TO number_of_orders
ALTER TABLE account_user ALTER COLUMN number_of_orders SET DEFAULT 0
ALTER TABLE account_user ADD CONSTRAINT account_user_orders_nn CHECK (number_of_orders IS NOT NULL) NOT VALID
ALTER TABLE account_user VALIDATE CONSTRAINT account_user_orders_nn
ALTER TABLE account_user ALTER COLUMN number_of_orders SET NOT NULL
ALTER TABLE account_user DROP CONSTRAINT account_user_orders_nn
ALTER TABLE account_user ADD CONSTRAINT account_user_number_of_orders_check CHECK (number_of_orders >= 0) NOT VALID
ALTER TABLE account_user VALIDATE CONSTRAINT account_user_number_of_orders_check
